description: This file defines a Java interface 'ModifyCommandAdapterProvider' with generic parameters for modify commands and responses. It provides method signatures for obtaining adapters for modify commands and responses, serving as a part of the protocol adapter provider package within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: A Java interface that provides methods to obtain adapters for modify commands and their responses, parameterized by the specific signal and command response types.

methods.name: getModifyCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns an Adapter for the modify command of type M.

methods.name: getModifyCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns an Adapter for the modify command response of type R.
